feeds.title: Let's Grow Wild Blog » Smallholding
feeds.description: Let's Grow Wild Blog is a gardening blog founded by Stephanie Hafferty, a smallholder, and permaculture designer. The blog covers a range of topics related to gardening, including growing vegetables, herbs, and fruits, as well as raising chickens and bees. The mission of the blog is to inspire others to grow their own food and lead a sustainable lifestyle.

feeds.title: Townie on a NZ Smallholding
feeds.description: Townie on a NZ Smallholding Blog is a personal blog founded by Sarah, who moved from the city to a smallholding in New Zealand. The blog covers their experiences of running a smallholding, including raising livestock, growing vegetables, and living off the land. The vision of the blog is to encourage others to embrace a more sustainable lifestyle and become more self-sufficient.

feeds.title: The Country Smallholder News
feeds.description: This blog was started by Liz Shankland, a former journalist and author, in 2007. The blog aims to provide smallholders with advice, tips and inspiration on all aspects of smallholding, including livestock, poultry, horticulture, and lifestyle. Liz Shankland's mission is to help people achieve their smallholding dreams and build a sustainable future.

feeds.title: Hollow Ash
feeds.description: This blog is run by Lucy and her family who have a smallholding in Wales. The blog provides insights into their daily lives, their animals, gardening, and sustainability. Lucy's mission is to live a simple, self-sufficient life and to inspire others to do the same.

feeds.title: The Ark Smallholding Blog
feeds.description: The Ark Smallholding is run by Karen and her family in the UK. They have a passion for raising rare breed animals and growing their own food. The blog provides an honest account of their smallholding journey, including the challenges they face and the lessons they learn. Karen's mission is to encourage others to live a sustainable lifestyle and to show that smallholding is possible on any scale.

feeds.title: Tyddyn Bryn Blog
feeds.description: Tyddyn Bryn is a smallholding in North Wales run by Llinos and her family. The blog covers topics such as gardening, beekeeping, poultry keeping and sustainable living. Llinos's mission is to inspire others to take up smallholding and to promote sustainable living in her local community.

feeds.title: Tiny Farm Blog
feeds.description: A day-to-day photo-journal of organic market gardening: growing local food with two acres and some tools! I started this tiny farming blog in earnest about a year ago, with the clear idea that it was simply about my gardening efforts, about growing stuff. I didn't begin with a cause or a philosophical platform. I wasn't blogging with any audience in mind, it was just a personal field journal, available online, and as such, there was no central spot for politics.

feeds.title: Rails Farm Blog
